title: North Indian
description: Rich, creamy dishes like butter chicken, paneer tikka, and naan. Known for bold spices and dairy-based gravies.

title: South Indian
description: Famous for dosas, idlis, and sambar. Features rice-based meals, coconut, curry leaves, and mustard seeds.

title: East Indian
description: Light and flavorful dishes like momos, fish curry, and sweets like rasgulla. Often includes mustard oil and rice.

title: West Indian
description: Includes Gujarati, Rajasthani, and Maharashtrian cuisines. Offers spicy snacks, dhokla, and thalis.

title: Central Indian
description: Staples like bhutte ka kees, poha, and dal bafla. A blend of flavors from neighboring regions.
